# 🧹 Maintenance Checklist

## Repository integrity
- [ ] Q1-Q5 exist.
- [ ] Original image assets remain present.
- [ ] Existing output screenshots remain present.
- [ ] README structure matches actual tree.

## Validation
- [ ] Run Python structural validator.
- [ ] Check Markdown links.
- [ ] Review Mermaid syntax.
- [ ] Open changed pages in browser.

## Governance
- [ ] Review security reports.
- [ ] Review open issues and pull requests.
- [ ] Review GitHub Actions and permissions.
- [ ] Review Dependabot updates.

## Documentation
- [ ] Update changelog.
- [ ] Update known issues.
- [ ] Update roadmap.
- [ ] Record unverified areas honestly.

## Sign-off
Maintainer, date, commit:
